programme.desc:
Luke Cranney has been guiding sheep in Idaho for 11 years, and packing in Alaska for 2. Everything lined up, and he got the chance to go on a hunt of his own. However, unlike many sheep hunts they had no scouting or plan in place. This was a true adventure hunt filled with bad weather, beautiful animals, and uncanny good luck. Follow Luke, Austin and Brady on an experience they will never forget.

programme.title: Turkey Bezoar Ibex Adventure with Jason Price
programme.desc: Follow along as Jason Price heads to Turkey for one of the most sought after ibex in the world. The destination, mountains & animals made this one of the most incredible adventures we've ever been on!

programme.title: Kentucky Archery Whitetail Experience with Charlotte Catlin
programme.desc: Char Catlin travels to Kentucky to hunt Whitetails with Salt River Outfitters. Faced with a quick shot Char's persistence and never give up attitude results in a terrific Kentucky Whitetail Buck!!!

programme.title: The Tien Shan Experience Hunting Mid Asian Ibex in Kyrgyzstan
programme.desc: Andy Moeckel @flipflopguy and Lucas Paugh take us along on their once in a lifetime experience hunting mid-asian ibex at 14,000 feet in Kyrgyzstan.

programme.title: 18 Years In The Making - Colorado Mountain Goat Hunt with TJ Sanchez
programme.desc: Anyone who puts in for the draw knows that premium tags are really hard to come by. Tj put his time in on the Colorado draw and, finally after 18yrs was lucky enough to get a mountain goat tag in his home state.

programme.title: Alberta Big Horn Hunting, 37 Days for a Dream Ram
programme.desc: A grueling 37 day hunt in the Canadian wilderness! Join Jason Price as he hunts for his Grand Slam sheep, the Rocky Mountain bighorn over three separate trips.

programme.title: Spanish Ibex Slam with Dan Catlin
programme.desc: Dan Catlin travels to the beautiful country of Spain in pursuit of all 4 Spanish Ibex. Join Dan on his incredible EXPERIENCE hunting the Gredos, Beceite, Ronda, and Southeastern ibex!

programme.title: Mongolia Wild Sheep Experience!
programme.desc: Follow along as THE EXPERIENCE travels to the ends of the earth in search of the largest sheep species known to man. You won't want to miss this quest for the Hangay Argali and Altai Ibex! AND never before seen footage of a wild Snow Leopard!

programme.title: Giant Alaskan Yukon Moose Grand Slam Club Ovis North American Big Game
programme.desc: On this Episode of The Experience we are hunting giant Alaskan Yukon Moose! Definitely an Experience of a lifetime chasing around Grand Slam Club Ovis North American Big Game!

programme.title: Kentucky Whitetail with Dan Catlin
programme.desc: In this episode of The Experience, Dan Catlin takes us on his Whitetail deer archery hunt in the great state of Kentucky with Salt River Outfitters! This story does have a sweet ending, but as all bow hunters understand regarding shot placement, you can be a hero or a zero within a fraction of an inch. Dan keeps it real as he shows us the ups and the downs of his experience in the Kentucky deer woods!

programme.title: Marco Polo, The Pinnacle of Tajikistan with TJ Sanchez
programme.desc: T.J. Sanchez travels to Tajikistan in the search for what most sheep hunters believe to be the Pinnacle of "Big Game Hunting"! The Marco Polo of Tajikistan are one of the largest sheep species in the world. The harsh, cold environment and sometimes elevations of more than 17,000 feet make this one of the most challenging as well as one of the most remote hunts on the planet.

programme.title: Giant Mexico Mule Deer Youth Hunt with Ethan Price
programme.desc: Ethan travels to Mexico with his father to hunt the BIG Sonoran Muley Bucks of Mexico

programme.title: The Turkish Experience
programme.desc: Brian Rhead heads to Turkey with Shikar Safaris in search of one of the most beautiful Ibex Species in the world. The overall Experience of Turkey makes this one of the greatest adventures in the world.

programme.title: Archery Red Stag EXPERIENCE
programme.desc: Bow hunting Red Stag on the South Island of New Zealand with Venator Cardrona Safaris! Charlotte Catlin climbs to the summit in search of one of the worlds most sought after trophies with her ARCHERY equipment only! This hunt showcases one of the most beautiful places on earth so you will NOT want to miss this one!

programme.title: Mongolia Maral Stag Hunt
programme.desc: The Experience takes you to all corners of the world in search of what we are all seeking, THE EXPERIENCE! Aaron Rees travels to Mongolia for the trip of a lifetime! Follow along as he travels around the entire country for 14 days hunting 3 different species in some absolutely breathtaking country! This is MONGOLIA!

programme.title: Busted Up Bulls
programme.desc: Dan Catlin heads to New Mexico in search of migrating bulls headed towards their winter range. You never know what you might find on a hunt like this but two things are for sure, lots of glassing & you're going to see some BUSTED UP BULLS!

programme.title: Dan Catlin Dall Sheep 2013 Vault Film
programme.desc: Still one of my greatest adventures; the start of a sheep hunting journey that I could have never imagined. - Dan Catlin

programme.title: Hunting Dall Sheep - The Quest for 4
programme.desc: This was a very special hunt in the Brooks Range of Northern Alaska with one of our closest friends, Bob Summers of Deltana Outfitters back in August of 2015.

programme.title: Taking a Bow to a Gun Fight
programme.desc: We had the opportunity to follow Devin Leonard around the hills for 10 days as he was torn between his passion for bowhunting or increasing his odds of success and reaching for his rifle. You don't want to miss this elk hunting film.

programme.title: BC Book Mountain Goat
programme.desc: Hunting Mountain Goats in British Columbia! This hunt was filmed back in 2015 and is the first of MANY of the archives will be putting together in between the current hunts!

programme.title: Bow Hunting Wasatch Moose
programme.desc: This is where it all started for Dallas Hemeyer, Filming moose hunting on the Wasatch front for friends & family. For years he made it on every hunt he could fit into his schedule trying to log film & photos to hopefully turn this into a career one day. Well as you've probably seen he has done just that and come a long way since 2014! But we all start somewhere and this is where Dallas got his start.

programme.title: California Big Horn Determination
programme.desc: Russ Hawkins was well on his way to successfully hunting all four of the North American Sheep when he suffered a terrible injury that left him almost completely paralyzed. After extensive rehab and a never give up attitude, Russ once again found himself on the mountains chasing what most in the hunting industry perceive as the greatest big game hunting accomplishment!

programme.title: The Australian Water Buffalo Experience
programme.desc: Mark Peterson travels to the land down under in pursuit of Australian Water Buffalo.

programme.title: Under The Influence - Canada Stone Sheep
programme.desc: If you hunt sheep, there had to be someone or something that influenced you. My name is Dallas Cota and I was hooked after a close friend took me out for 5 miserable days on an Alberta Bighorn sheep hunt. A couple years later, I harvested my Bighorn and soon after that, I booked a Dall's sheep hunt in the Yukon. I'll never forget the day I told Jason Hairston I was booked to hunt white sheep, his response "Right on! Next up will be your Stone sheep!" I candidly laughed until I realized he wasn't joking. He assured me that someday it would happen, if I wanted it bad enough. I owe a lot to my influencers, without them, I would never have been "under the influence".

programme.title: Tajikistan Experience #3 - A Dream Come True
programme.desc: Mark Sullins chases a lifelong dream in Tajikistan with Neal and Brownlee Outfitters!

programme.title: Hunting Dagestan Tur with Shikar Safaris
programme.desc: Jason Price travels to the steep slopes and unforgiving terrain of Azerbaijan in pursuit of the Dagestan Tur. Some believe this to be one of the most physically challenging and difficult hunts in the World!

programme.title: Canadian Cold Weather Whitetail EXPERIENCE
programme.desc: Dan Catlin travels north of the boarder to Saskatchewan Canada in search of a dark horned wilderness whitetail with Worldwide Trophy Adventures (WTA). Braving temps of -40 degrees Dan connects on a big bodied Canadian whitetail that is his largest buck to date. Hunting is certainly NOT judged by the number of inches, but by the EXPERIENCES we enjoy. You won't want to miss this EXPERIENCE in the frozen Canadian wilderness…

programme.title: Mexico Whitetail Deer Hunting Experience!
programme.desc: The Experience travelled south of the border in to Old Mexico for some dark horned Mexican whitetail deer hunting. From the deep snow in Canada to the cactus country of Mexico, there's no where Dan Catlin won't go in search of a Deer Hunting EXPERIENCE!

programme.title: The Boulder Elk Experience with TJ Sanchez
programme.desc: TJ Sanchez has played the waiting game for a Utah Elk permit for almost 20 years. In 2023, he finally drew the one Non Resident Muzzleloader tag in one of the top units in the state, the Boulder. After 12 days hunting public land, TJ finally got his opportunity at a Bull of a lifetime.

programme.title: I Can, and I Will - Zane Foust Dall Sheep
programme.desc: To some, hunting is a weekend adventure... it's something you do to pass the cold winter months. To others, it's a passion, maybe a lifestyle. To Zane Foust, and many others like him, it's an escape to a place he loves, away from the hospital and the doctor's office. Hunting is his inspiration in life to keep going, to keep fighting. A special thanks to Frank Maestri for his huge heart and generosity that made this hunt possible!

programme.title: Bow Hunting for Whitetail in Iowa
programme.desc: Follow Dan Catlin's quest for a Whitetail Deer in Iowa. Patiently, they wait all week until finally, they see the perfect opportunity to complete his EXPERIENCE!

programme.title: Saskatchewan Black Bear with Mark Peterson
programme.desc: Mark Peterson travels to Saskatchewan in search of Black Bear with his bow!

programme.title: The Half Slam Experience
programme.desc: Follow Char Catlin's quest for the 4 North American Wild Sheep as she heads to Ole Mexico in search of a Desert Bighorn Sheep. Char collected a 10 plus year old ram that anyone would be proud to take!

programme.title: Spain Experience, Beceite and Gredos Ibex with Shikar Safaris
programme.desc: Jason Price travels to Spain in pursuit of the Beceite and Gredos Ibex. Spain has an abundance of game with a variety of species! Due to such large populations, great accommodations and incredible food, hunting the Beceite and Greedos Ibex are typically easier than most other goat hunts around the world. Filmed by Sawyer Peacock edited by Warner Brown.

programme.title: Largest Public Land Ram in Utah 194"
programme.desc: We were very fortunate to play a roll in capturing Kyle Ekker's hunt on film. Kyle Ekker grew up in Green River Utah where he developed his love of hunting, chasing mulies on the Book Cliffs. He has worked for the Emery County Sheriff's Office for 30 years where he is currently employed as a captain. He has been a member of the Utah FNAWS for the last 10 years and through this he is able to share his passion for the outdoors & wild sheep. In December of 2015 he drew the highly coveted Rocky Mountain Bighorn Sportsman's permit. This tag gave him the opportunity to hunt sheep from the beginning of September to December 31st on almost any open units in the state. He hunted every opportunity that he had he could in pursuit of his dream ram. On November 30th things came together for him and he was able to harvest a very magnificent ram. With an unofficial green score of 194" this ram will be the largest public land ram ever killed in the state of Utah.

programme.title: Deja Vu Youth Whitetail Experience
programme.desc: Grand Slam Club Ovis "Youth 3 Antler". It seems like yesterday that Casey and I were hunting whitetails as kids. It was an incredible Experience having the opportunity to take our boys back to where it all began! In this episode 7 year old Ethan gets a chance at his first Texas Whitetail buck; while 9 year old seasoned whitetail hunter Drew goes for one as well. Hope you all enjoy this Texas free range whitetail management hunt!

programme.title: Mid Asian Ibex - The Kyrgyzstan Experience with Shikar Safaris
programme.desc: Jason Price travels to the Tian Shan Mountains of Kyrgyzstan with Worldwide Trophy Adventures and Shikar Safaris in pursuit of some of the largest ibex in the world. Hunting is done on horseback as well as spot and stalk. Jason and Sawyer find a literal hole in the wall for shelter as they endure extreme weather conditions on a hunt of a lifetime!

programme.title: Mexico Desert Bighorn Sheep Hunting
programme.desc: Follow along as Dan Catlin hunts Desert Sheep in Sonora Mexico! Ever since his first sheep experience in Alaska Dan knew completing the Grand Slam of sheep was something that he was going to accomplish in this lifetime. We hope you enjoy this film as Dan attempts to knock off Ram #2 on the quest for 4!

programme.title: Ole Mexico Sonora Mule Deer with Jim Beltz
programme.desc: Jim Beltz gets the opportunity of a lifetime to hunt Ole Mexico for a Sonora Mule Deer. Follow along as a good old boy from Michigan spends a week with the Mexico based Roca Taxidermy in search of Mucho Grande bucks!

programme.title: FINDING FORESTS RAM Grand Slam Club Ovis Youth 3 Horn

programme.title: A Son's First Big Game Hunting Experience
programme.desc: TJ Sanchez hunts antelope in New Mexico for the first time with his son, and passes on the family tradition.

programme.title: "Red of Iran" Jason Hunts Iranian Red Sheep Free Range in Texas
programme.desc: Jason Price hunts Iranian Red Sheep in his home state of Texas.

programme.title: The Billy Named Nanny 4K Video
programme.desc: Follow along as Dallas & Sawyer head to B.C. on a last minute goat hunt! It's late in the season, weather is moving in and they had the experience of a lifetime.

programme.title: Kansas Whitetail Experience TJ Sanchez
programme.desc: TJ's good friend Perry Madl invites him to Kansas to become the first rifle hunter on his family ranch in 30 years. After a few days of hunting and reviewing trail camera photos, things start to unfold, and an old buck is found.

programme.title: The Gobi Vault Film - Dan Catlin Mongolia Gobi Argali
programme.desc: Dan Catlin travels to Mongolia on a dream hunt! After a lot of travel, delayed camera man and lost luggage and gun, Dan makes the best of it with a great Gobi Argali!

programme.title: Bowhunting New Mexico Ibex with Devin Leonard
programme.desc: For 17 days Devin bow hunted the Florida Mountains of New Mexico chasing the Bezoar Ibex. It's one of, if not the most difficult bow hunt in North America with less than a 2% success rate! Follow along as Devin Leonard puts his skills to the test on a true hunt of a lifetime.

programme.title: Giant Alaskan Black Bear
programme.desc: On our way back to camp from packing out Jason's moose we spotted a GIANT BEAR feeding on blue berries less than 500 yards from the tents.

programme.title: Mexico Whitetail Experience, Christmas style!
programme.desc: Travel south of the border for some archery hunting action in one of our favorite places, Ole Mexico.

programme.title: Alberta Big Horn EXPERIENCE!
programme.desc: Follow Char Catlin's quest for the Grand Slam as she collected her 3rd ram, Rocky Mountain Big Horn, with Scalp Creek Outfitters. Hunting with Rob, Brenda, Gordon and Glen has become a family tradition. This hunt is about WAY MORE than collecting a Ram. Kristy and Yogi also spend three days getting their Wyoming Hunter Ed certification, as well as their Instructor Certification! Exciting times...this is, Our Wyld Life!

programme.title: Western Hunting & Conservation Expo / Our Wyld Life / EP1
programme.desc:
Welcome to Our Wyld Life where host Kristy Titus and her husband, Yogi, take viewers along on their day-to-day lives, full of adventure. After relocating to Wyoming, hunting, outdoor and shooting sports recreation are literally in their backyard. The couple is truly making their home on the range while developing their new homestead and enjoying life in the cowboy state.
In our premiere episode, we show you a little bit of what it's like being a Wyoming resident, in the winter. After a tough start, Kristy makes it a great week with familiar faces and many new ones, in what is one of the most fun shows of the year! If you didn't make it in 2023, it's a must to attend next year! Also, you'll be introduced to the newest (and longest eared) members of the family! Kristy shows off her baby mules...lots more of the mules to come! When they aren't out on an adventure trekking deep into the backcountry with their horses and mules, you'll find them preparing for the next opportunity to do so.
Our Wyld Life presents the journey of life out west in Wyoming.

programme.title: What are the Chances
programme.desc:
Luke Cranney has been guiding sheep in Idaho for 11 years, and packing in Alaska for 2. Everything lined up, and he got the chance to go on a hunt of his own. However, unlike many sheep hunts they had no scouting or plan in place. This was a true adventure hunt filled with bad weather, beautiful animals, and uncanny good luck. Follow Luke, Austin and Brady on an experience they will never forget.

programme.title: Largest Public Land Ram in Utah 194"
programme.desc: We were very fortunate to play a roll in capturing Kyle Ekker's hunt on film. Kyle Ekker grew up in Green River Utah where he developed his love of hunting, chasing mulies on the Book Cliffs. He has worked for the Emery County Sheriff's Office for 30 years where he is currently employed as a captain. He has been a member of the Utah FNAWS for the last 10 years and through this he is able to share his passion for the outdoors & wild sheep. In December of 2015 he drew the highly coveted Rocky Mountain Bighorn Sportsman's permit. This tag gave him the opportunity to hunt sheep from the beginning of September to December 31st on almost any open units in the state. He hunted every opportunity that he had he could in pursuit of his dream ram. On November 30th things came together for him and he was able to harvest a very magnificent ram. With an unofficial green score of 194" this ram will be the largest public land ram ever killed in the state of Utah.

programme.title: Cape Buffalo Charge

Every hunt is different, every hunt is risky, and every hunt is completely thrilling! Watch now and follow the adventure!

programme.title: Hunting with a Lost Lemming: Okayest Hunter's 2022 deer hunting season kickoff!
programme.desc:
The crew from the Okayest Hunter podcast thought it'd be a good idea to start a hunting show, but they wanted to do something different, and it needed to align with the brand, mission, and ethos of the Okayest Hunter. Basically, it can't be too serious. So we thought, hey, let's make the "Office" show, but for hunting.
Our hunting season is chock full of humility as we miss place things, take too long to pick out our tree, injure ourselves, miss deer, lose arrows, and more. However, we had one of our best and most fun seasons yet! Follow along as we release new episodes as our 2022 deer hunting season unfolds. We assure you it'll be worth getting all the way to the end!
Cheers to chasing shooter bucks in the deer woods and never passing on what makes you happy! We hope you can relate as we share our shenanigans with everyone!
Okayest Hunter Show, season one: We'll See How it Goes, Episode one: Hunting with a lost lemming.

programme.title: Spring Turkey Extravaganza [Part II]
programme.desc: After Eric shot his first bird in part I of the Okayest Hunter's first turkey hunt, he get's to do all the other firsts with his gobbler. Eric learns what a limb hanger is, or in this case isn't. He also learns how to field dress his first turkey.

programme.title: Pope and Young
programme.desc: Corey talks about his first Pope and young experience. A tale about the heart pounding moment we all dream of feeling as a huge buck heads your way. This Wisconsin Giant makes the mistake of walking into close range.

programme.title: Giants in Green Bay
programme.desc: Mathew is joined by Cindy Braun the CEO of AMS Bowfishing as they travel to Green Bay Wisconsin in pursuit of giant common carp. Also known as Title Town USA home of the Green Bay Packers but also giant Carp. Also known for its world class Walleye fishing, these invasive carp must be kept in check as they destroy spawning habitat for the native fish. Non-stop bowfishing action as the Giants of Green Bay move into the shallows and make for some great night time bowfishing.

programme.desc: An embarrassed hiker changes her clothes and joins a search party in Iceland to find....... herself. Turkey harvesting in Missouri hit huge numbers this season, but there's no need to worry, their population is flourishing due to conservation efforts. Have you been foraging lately without knowing the state regulations? A man collecting morel mushrooms in Missouri didn't and was caught by the park ranger. One hiker was killed and another injured by a man who has now been caught by authorities thanks to a GPS tracker. programme.title: Ghost Stories, Crayfish of Unusual Size and Turkey Invasions
programme.desc: On this episode of Outdoor Weekly we have ghosts? Aliens? Bigfoot? Escaped government experiment looking to exact revenge on those that condemned it to a life of torment and misery? Or maybe it's just a jogger. Check out the trail cam footage and listen to this guy's story and you can be the judge. We also have a North Dakota man who thinks he broke the state record for walleye but it is disqualified for one key reason. A Pennsylvania man who DOES break a state record for catfish and no he didn't use mousefish as bait. Crayfish, crawfish, crawdad, it doesn't matter what you call it, a water plant worker found a MASSIVE specimen that could have been mistaken for a lobster. A new gang is stirring up trouble in a rural town – a gang of turkeys are terrorizing residents. And last but not least, we check in with the beautiful Jana Waller to give us updates on this year's bear season.

programme.title: Don't Miss
programme.desc: Watch this cinematic adventure as Paul Lawver and Joel Port hit public land on the Eastern Shore of Maryland chasing Sika a.k.a. the elusive marsh ghosts. Sika deer (technically a species of the elk family) were released in the swamps of Maryland in the early 1900's. Sika originate from Thailand/Japan/East Asia and have flourished in Maryland so well, their season co-insides with whitetail yet have their own separate bag limits.

programme.title: Slow down for more birds
programme.desc:
You set the pace in the field, and if you're in a rush so is your dog. That means less time in a scent cone and more missed birds.
Scott Linden of Wingshooting USA TV shows you how, and explains why, you should dial things down a bit when it comes to covering a field or covert.
If you want more tips on dog training and bird hunting, go to: www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Hunting dog tailgate exam, part one
programme.desc:
Your best hunting partner needs some TLC ... especially after a hunt. wingshooting USA TV host Scott Linden provides the first part of three, helping you check him from nose tip to tail and ensure he's healthy, safe, and ready to go the next day.
Today, it's all about your dog's coat. We'll cover why it's important to get him off the ground, how "training" for the exam is critical, and what to look for from injuries to parasites. Your dog will stay healthier, well-rested, and ready to go the next day.
You'll also see some fun and exciting bird hunting footage from a hunt where the tailgate exam became crucial.

programme.title: Take a newcomer hunting - here's how
programme.desc:
Safety first, but then what? Author and TV host Scott Linden outlines some ways to encourage, motivate, and then help a new hunter on their first hunt.
From weather to shooting tips, to interacting with the dog, and what really counts on the hunt, Scott offers suggestions to ensure everyone has fun.
For more tips on hunting, dog training, and finding places to go: www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Identify your best prospect for a new hunter
programme.desc:
Picking the right new hunting partner is an art and a science ... and while there's no wrong way, some ways are righter than others. Author/TV host Scott Linden outlines some tips on finding the right person, how to set expectations, and what to tell them - and show them - before you make "the ask."
For more tips, go to www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: The new-hunter best recruiter is your dog!
programme.desc:
Who doesn't love hunting dogs? The magic of their performance, excitement, and the adrenaline rush of a flush! One easy way to start a new hunter is to invite them to help train your dog.
Simple, short, convenient - there's no downside. And who wouldn't appreciate a little help with dog training?
Plus, some cool footage of a hunt with excellent dog works.
For more on starting a hunter, finding places to hunt, and dog training, go to www.findbirdhuntingspots.com.

programme.title: Ideas for finding new places to hunt
programme.desc:
Find upland birds on waterfowl production areas, and more tips on accessing public hunting areas are two of the topics ... as well as a great place to headquarter: Huron, South Dakota.
Watch some exciting bird hunting footage, too.
Find more information at www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Tailgate exam, part 2: wheels
programme.desc:
Part two covers your dog's "wheels," his feet. Enure a fantastic hunt tomorrow by keeping his feet healthy and injury-free with these step-by-step, toe-by-toe instructions.
Geet the entire exam in written form at HappyJackInc.com.

programme.title: Be nice, see where it gets you
programme.desc:
Walk-in hunting spots are not always easy to find. Here's an example of how to find them and the bonuses you might find along the way.
From hunting with a pro baseball player, to finding a black pheasant, to discovering new public-access spots in Huron, SD, there's a few lessons here.
Plus, some fun footage of a South Dakota pheasant hunt.
For more tips, go to www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Peak performance on Day Two: feed your dog strategically
programme.desc:
In the first 20 days of this season, my wirehair Flick had already hunted over 200 miles. He still scratches the RV door every morning, eager for another day of chukar chasing and quail quests.
I manage to keep up (mostly) with coffee and pain reliever. Flick, on the other paw, gets his stamina from Dr. Tim's dog food.
If your dog hunts multiple days in a row, it might be worth a look at how important food is to his performance. I asked Doctor Tim Hunt to share his thoughts on that, but first, a hunting story.

programme.title: Tailgate exam, Part 3: His steering wheel
programme.desc:
Okay, we've checked his body, his feet. But the tailgate exam isn't over until you've checked a dog's head – the steering wheel of your hunting machine. Like your truck, you're not getting very far without one! Put off that tall cold one for a couple more minutes. You'll have a fully-functioning hunting partner for the next day … and you won't die of thirst!
In this video, I'll show you where to look, what to look for and why ... and also how to remedy most common issues that might kibosh your next day's hunt, from getting stuff out of eyes and ears, to ensuring weeds and crud stay outta those places and more!
I'll take you step-by-step through all the deep, dark places that harbor danger and irritation on your dog's head so he's ready and rested for the next day's hunt.
And if you need remedies for any of the problems outlined, you can find them at www.happyjackinc.com.

programme.title: Get high, become a better bird hunter
programme.desc:
Not like that! I mean, boost your altitude - even just a bit - and you'll be able to keep a closer eye on your dog. If you're paying attention, you'll have a crucial half-second extra to get ready for a safe, sure shot.
I'll show you how - what you might use to get "up there" a little, what to look for in your dog's behavior, and why it's worth the effort.

programme.title: What's in my vest ... and why
programme.desc:
"Don't leave home without" is more than a cliche' from a TV commercial. What should you take on your next bird hunt, for you and your dog? Here's some advice on critical stuff, and what you might leave home ... without jeopardizing your safety or comfort - or you're dog's!
Somewhere in my personal vest is everything I need to shoot as well as possible (no smart remarks, please), stay found or get found, keep my dog safe and healthy, and help me survive a night or two in an emergency.
I'll show you all of it, and how to keep it from getting lost somewhere in the middle of nowhere!

programme.title: Your dog hurts - here's why
programme.desc:
I seem to be getting a lot of related questions since the season ended – most about aches and pains in our four-footed hunting buddies. And us!
The difference is, dogs won't show it like we do, with gripes and limping, complaints and wincing. They are way too loyal and hard working. It's why we love 'em.
You might already know this, but veterinarians tell me dogs seldom show pain. What they do, is slow down. Their pace in the field drags, they're slow to get out of their crate.
Maybe they won't jump onto your tailgate or training table.
That's probably arthritis, and it affects most dogs over eight years old. But here's the scary part: twenty percent of dogs show signs as early as one year old.
In this video, I'll show you how to prevent arthritis, manage it if your dog already has it, and what to avoid so he doesn't get it prematurely!

programme.title: Fuel your bird dog's peak performance ... but NOT with carbs!
programme.desc:
We hunt to watch our dogs work. So, stand by for plenty of that. But first, let me relate my last season. I tracked Flick's mileage. He averaged twenty-five miles a day, over almost fifty days in the field. I'm a lousy shooter, and okay trainer … so I'll attribute his stamina to my dumb luck, and his performance dog food.
If you want to watch your dog in the field day after day, heed some of the advice I got from Doctor Tim Hunt, a veterinarian, sled dog racer, and developer of the food Flick eats. He says the fuel you put in your dog directly impacts his ability to hunt hard, especially on a long hunting trip. He should know. His food has powered a bunch of Iditarod winners … and my guy Flick.
In this video, you'll learn what the key ingredients are in a dog food, how they work, and why. Hint: the most important component in your dog food is probably NOT what you think it is.

programme.title: Your bird dog's "suit of armor" and how it helps him reach his peak
programme.desc:
In previous videos, we've covered a dog's … headlights, wheels and steering wheel …
Now, it's time to cover a dog's largest organ, that I'll call his "body and paint," his skin and coat. Like a suit of armor, they protect a dog from virtually everything that can put him on the injured reserve list when he could be hunting.
To help you - and him - through a long season, I'll outline many of the problems that are easily handled without a vet visit, if you have a few things on hand, their potential causes, and what you can do about them so you both get back to hunting ASAP.
I'll also settle that proverbial campfire debate once and for all: are hair and fur are the same thing?

programme.title: Hunting dog peak performance on multi-day hunts
programme.desc:
There is a "magic dust" that can help your hunting dog's muscles recover overnight and keep him performing at his best on the second, third, and fourth days of a long hunting trip. The key is knowing what it is, how it works, and when to give it to him...and what NOT to give him at the same time!
I'll outline the how and why in this video ... plus some excellent dog work from Ruggs Ranch in Oregon just for fun!

programme.title: That ingredient sneaky dog food makers don't want you to know about
programme.desc:
Want less poop, and more dazzling performance from your hunting dog?
Generally, less poop means your dog food contains the highest-quality protein and his body is utilizing almost all of it.
But crafty dog food makers often hide the key ingredient ... the one that will tell ALL about the quality of the protein in your hunting dog's food. And it's the easiest way to tell how good your dog food is.
This ingredient is seldom on the label. You'll have to quit browsing puppy pictures on the Internet and go to the dog food maker's website. If you want more of his food fueling peak performance and less piling up in the yard, it's worth the effort.

programme.title: Four tips to get the most from your walk-in and public-access bird hunt

Your bird dog will thank you.

programme.title: 4 tips make your bird hunting road trip better ... for your dog

programme.title: Go along to get along in bird hunting country
programme.desc:
Be a good temporary neighbor in hunting hotspots like Huron, South Dakota, and you'll reap benefits of all sorts. Here's a "field guide" to getting the most from your hunting destination.
Dial it down: Things move a bit more deliberately in rural America; we can too. Breathe deep at the gas station, tavern or sporting goods store. Fit in, and residents will welcome you … you'll have "a guy" in town.
Good guest: Let's give as good as we get: buy local, drive like locals, drink like locals. "Pay it forward," respect diverse values, and wire gates open more often.
It's their office: Cattle, crops, drilling, are part of the economic landscape. Empty shotgun shells can sideline a combine. Cows are walking thousand-dollar bills. An unattended campfire is like burning down someone's office.
The downside is obvious: locked gates, drive-by's while wrestling a flat tire. The payoff is also crystal clear: access, friends when you need them, useful information, textures and colors that make a hunting trip truly epic. Well, unless you shoot like me.
Free info pack: Access maps, Discounts, Prizes
I learned most of these lessons in the Ringneck Nation of Huron, South Dakota and so can you. Go to HuntHuronSD.com and request a free information pack and you're entered to win one of three hunting trip prize packages. See you there.

The martial artist lifestyle helped bring structure to all areas of Chris' life. He believes he has become a better person through Martial Arts, and he makes the mental distinction between between being a fighter and being Martial Artist. He prefers the standup game feels he is progressing well to being an all around fighter with his BJJ Blue Belt.

programme.title: BEONDTV is a Los Angeles-based broadcast and digital media network with a wide variety of original programming curated by Emmy award-winning journalists and content creators.
BEONDTV is a Los Angeles-based broadcast and digital media network with a wide variety of original programming curated by Emmy award-winning journalists and content creators.
Desperate Hours - S01:E02 - Earthquake
programme.desc: When the Earth really moves, it means disaster on an epic scale. Desperate Hours looks at the destructive force of earthquakes and looks at the 2015 Kathmandu earthquake in Nepal, the 2008 Sichuan earthquake in China where an estimated 10,000 children were trapped in collapsed school buildings, a 1960 Puerto Mont earthquake in Chile, the 2010 Port-au-Princ earthquake in Haiti, and the 2005 Kashmir earthquake in Pakistan.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E03 - Epidemic
programme.desc: Desperate Hours looks at major epidemics including the African Ebola outbreak in Sudan which eventually led to cases in the United State and England, the Indian Smallpox outbreak in Bihar, the African Cholera outbreak, the SARS outbreak in Guanghzhou China, and the Bird Flu of Hong Kong.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E04 - Wind
programme.desc: Desperate Hours looks at the destructive power of wind. From the devastating power of Hurricane Katrina in New Orleans to the destructive Cyclone Nargis in Myanmar, the 1960 storm Hurricane Donna in Florida, Tornado Joplin in Missouri, and Hurricane Sandy in New York.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E05 - Fire
programme.desc: The blazing terror of a fire can match anything in creation for sheer menace. Desperate Hours looks at the destructive force of fires including the Black Saturday Bushfires in Victoria Australia, the Station Nightclub fire in Rhode Island, the L'Innovation Department Store fire in Brussels Belgium, the Armoury fire in Lagos Nigeria, and the Binhai New Development Zone Fire in Tianjin China.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E07 - Iraqi Sniper Attack
programme.desc: On deployment in Anbar Province, Marine Corp Master Sergeant Buck Doyle throws himself in harms way to save a fallen comrade from an Iraqi sniper and becomes a target himself.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E08 - Lightning Strike
programme.desc: A bass fishing trip goes horribly wrong when a bolt of lightning strikes their boat, leaving Seventeen-year-old Christian Neal burned and unconscious and his father Gabe blown into the water and paralyzed. It will take a miracle to save them.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E27 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 1
programme.desc: As royal wives, both Diana and Fergie experienced a life filled with loneliness and sadness, despite their high hopes of bringing change to the House of Windsor. What was supposed to be their 'fairy-tale' lives ended up being far from that reality.

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E03 - Operation Waterfall
programme.desc: Snow in Montana makes the water dangerous, but the yearly boat float goes on. Watch Montana Game Wardens as they check the rivers to keep boaters safe and following the rules.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E05 - Saddle Sores
programme.desc: The guys are feeling great as they leave sheep territory, but the 22-hour trip to Tom-Tom, the first moose camp, feels endless. It'll take them two long days of riding to get there. As they head into moose land with a successful sheep packed up high, trouble always seems just around the corner on their journey. After riding for eight hours, issues start cropping up.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E04 - Naturally Exotic
programme.desc: This Episode of Miracles of Nature takes you on a journey from the Antigua in the Caribbean to the favourite of climbers - the Blue Mountains of New South Wales, Australia and then back to the Caribbean to admore in the beauty of The British Virgin Islands with stunning white beaches and turquoise waters.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E05 - Naturally Fierce
programme.desc: Visit the wintry North Pole from the comfort of your settee as this episode takes us on a journey to the icy Artic and then to Quebec to watch the most southernly fjord set at low tide, before journeying on to Alberta to take in the magnitude of the Sasquachuan River as it makes its way through the Rocky Mountains.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show - S01:E07 - Uga Bay, Sri Lanka and Istanbul
programme.desc: The Luxury Travel Show heads to the idyllic resort of Uga Beach in Sri Lanka for some unusual fine dining locations, with tall tables in the swimming pool and dug-out sunken tables in the sand. Then it’s off to Istanbul with a stay in one of the city’s best hotels - which has been transformed from a derelict tobacco factory into a palace fit for royalty.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show - S01:E08 - Grand Cayman and Toledo
programme.desc: Things hot up in this episode of The Luxury Travel Show as we head to the Caribbean island of Grand Cayman to a small town where visitors can literally send loved ones a postcard from Hell. The temperature dips only slightly in Toledo for a safari trip in Spain, with sunset drives, horse riding and clay pigeon shooting.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E09 - Darkness
programme.desc: Pakistan/Texas Pt2. Jim continues his hunt through extremely dangerous but also beautiful areas of Pakistan.

programme.title: Diana: In Search of Happiness
programme.desc: Experience an in-depth look at Princess Diana, the extraordinary woman of the 20th century. Featuring unique interviews and touching clips, this portrait captures her incredible journey to fame and her ability to overcome the emotional and physical challenges she encountered nearly every day.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E28 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 2
programme.desc: Diana, Princess of Wales, and Sarah, Duchess of York both married into the Queen's family, leaving in the midst of scandals, though their exits were quite different. Sadly, Diana passed away, while Sarah survived to start anew. Over time, their struggles can be better understood, and this documentary explores those challenges...

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E04 - Operation Snow Cat
programme.desc: Montana Game Wardens ride snowmobiles through the mountains in winter. It's elk hunting season, so they also make sure everyone is following the hunting rules.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E06 - Church on the Mountain
programme.desc: In the Yukon, decisions can change everything in a heartbeat, especially in such a tough landscape. The brothers are closing in on the enormous mountain grizzly, now just 500 yards away, and it's up to Chris to make the call.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E06 - Naturally Forged
programme.desc: In this episode of Miracles of Nature visits several different islands. Expect to see the breathtaking terrace rocks of Taiwan and the majestic volcano on the mythic island of Bali. On to the island of Jersey, after which a part of New York is named, and finally we visit the spectacular Madeira, which features an amazing variety of landscapes despite being a few kilometres in length.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E07 - Naturally Majestic
programme.desc: Follow in the footsteps of Indiana Jones. In this episode of Miracles of Nature we visit the wonders of the Gobi Desert which is one of the oldest deserts in the world, and then the contrasting lush, green hillsides of northern Mongolian. From there we travel 5000 kilometres to the south east to Jordan and the Dead Sea.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show - S01:E09 - Rennes and Provo
programme.desc: This gastronomic tour of Brittany stops off for crêpes in Rennes and Oysters in Cancale before visiting the historic walled city of St Malo. Then on to the island of Providenciales, known locally as Provo, in the Turks and Caicos Caribbean islands with buggy racing on the beach and a spot of shopping for some very expensive wines.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show - S01:E10 - Stockholm and Lisbon
programme.desc: For a weekend winter break, Stockholm has got to be one of most beautiful cities to visit. Made up of 14 separate islands, it’s one of the best-preserved and largest mediaeval cities in Europe. Then some summer sun in the Portuguese capitol, Lisbon, for a whistle stop cultural tour of the city and a surfing lesson along the coast.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E10 - The Ancient Ones
programme.desc: Arctic. Jim and Corey's Arctic adventure starts with Muskox, an animal practically forgotten since pre-historic times in the Arctic.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E32 - Prince William Royal Teenage Behind The Scenes
programme.desc: Who's the real person beneath all those glamorous royal photos? This intriguing documentary takes a look into the life of the young man behind the public image.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show - S01:E09 - Rennes and Provo
programme.desc: This gastronomic tour of Brittany stops off for crêpes in Rennes and Oysters in Cancale before visiting the historic walled city of St Malo. programme.title: Wardens - S02:E05 - Operation Litter Bug
programme.desc: Working to protect our treasured natural resources in some of the country's most secluded spots means there's never a boring day on the job.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E07 - Valley of Snow
programme.desc: The Keefer brothers are stuck at Church Camp as the snow keeps pounding down, and they can barely see anything. They're snowed in and don't know when they'll be able to continue their hunting trip. They're starting to face a bunch of problems.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E08 - Naturally Raw
programme.desc: This episode begins in Costa Rica, in an amazing rain forest. Here they make delicious chocolate out of cocoa beans. Mother Nature is at her magnificent best – showcasing hundreds of plant and animal species. And then to Kenya where green monkeys will be our tour-guides in the Lost City of Gedi plus a closer look at the wildlife which lives in very close proximity to the bustling streets of Nairobi.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E09 - Naturally Invigorating
programme.desc: Iceland: home to volcanic lakes and hot springs and mono-chromatic vistas. And then to Laos in South East Asia with its lush jungles, underground caves and water buffalo along the Mekong River.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show - S01:E11 - The Loire and Grenada
programme.desc: There’s more to the Loire Valley in France than wine. We’re on the Da Vinci trail, following in the last footsteps and final resting place of the great Leonardo da Vinci in the small town of Amboise, deep in the heart of the Loire. Then for the ultimate in relaxation it’s a pamper and spa break in Grenada.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show - S01:E12 - Venice and Northern Ireland
programme.desc: Venice, one of Europe’s most iconic and enchanting cities with its labyrinth of waterways and canals linking one hundred and eighteen separate islands. From Venetians to visitors, it’s the city where everyone oozes style. Then on to Northern Ireland, for a ghostly trail around a haunted hotel and a walk on the road to Winterfel, visiting some of the iconic locations featured HBO’s Games of Thrones series.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E11 - True North
programme.desc: Arctic Pt2. Inuit Elders provide guidance as Jim and Corey prepare to face the ice once again on a special invite to document a traditional Inuit hunting expedition.

programme.title: 10 Inch Hero
programme.desc: An artist gets a job at a beachside sandwich shop, where she hangs out with a techie, a flirt, a rocker, a hippie, and a Wiccan.

programme.title: Alien Trespass
programme.desc: After crash landing on the outskirts of a desert town, an alien enlists the help of a local waitress to recapture a monster that has escaped the wreckage of his spaceship in this affectionate, knowing, hilarious send-up of a genreís sillier past.

programme.title: Eavesdrop
programme.desc: Ensemble drama about conversations overheard in a bistro: two chess players see unfolding dramas, a couple on an uncomfortable blind date, a crumbling marriage, and film-noir fans that think they're witnessing a real-life murder.

programme.title: Citizen Duane
programme.desc: CITIZEN DUANE is a comedy/drama about Duane Balfour a teen-aged Don Quixote born into a family of spectacular failure. What starts as a simple schoolyard rivalry snowballs out of control when Duane decides to run for mayor of the tiny town of Ridgeway. If Duane is to succeed, he must not only overcome the powerful incumbents, but also his own inadequacies, public perception, and history itself.

programme.title: Comedy Meets Classic
programme.desc: Created by British comedy duo Carrington-Brown, based in Berlin, and Irish conductor ClA�odhna NA� AodA�in, based in Switzerland. They join forces with "The Swonderful Orchestra" for this exciting, classy, and hilarious music & comedy show.

programme.title: Flirting With Flamenco
programme.desc: When Sylvia's well-meaning dad (Watt) surprises her with a devastating revelation, Sylvia's world is turned upside down. But will she crumble or prove herself at the local flamenco contest? An uplifting feel-good Brit comedy drama, Flirting with Flamenco will have you laughing, crying and feeling empowered to turn your life around.

programme.title: Citizen Duane
programme.desc: CITIZEN DUANE is a comedy/drama about Duane Balfour a teen-aged Don Quixote born into a family of spectacular failure. What starts as a simple schoolyard rivalry snowballs out of control when Duane decides to run for mayor of the tiny town of Ridgeway. If Duane is to succeed, he must not only overcome the powerful incumbents, but also his own inadequacies, public perception, and history itself.

programme.title: The Flying Deuces
programme.desc: When two bumbling friends join the French Foreign Legion on a whim, they find themselves in a whirlwind of misadventures, love, and laughter as they attempt to navigate the challenges of military life in a foreign land.

programme.title: Perfect Girl
programme.desc: A coming of age romance for anyone who's ever had a crush. Since high school, Stan and Jenny have had crushes on each other. They wrote letters to one another over school holidays but in person they barely spoke; sharing only the occasional lingering glance and smile. Over the years they fantasized about how perfect they would be as lovers. Ten years later they bump into each other and have the chance to make it a reality, but it's not that simple; self doubt, fear of rejection, of losing their fantasies will hold them back from what could be the perfect union.

programme.title: I Would Have Kissed You
programme.desc: Three months after college graduation, best friends Mattie and Olivia are struggling to write a feature and struggling even more with their love lives. Mattie finds herself in a grey area with her college ex-boyfriend while Olivia clings to the hope that her crush will finally want to be with her (despite his hot new girlfriend.) British Web Awards - Awarded "Best Writing in a Dramedy" and "Best Music" Top Indie Awards -Awarded "Best Humor" WRPN Women's International Film Festival - Awarded "Exceptional Merit Award"

programme.title: The General
programme.desc: When Union spies steal Johnnie Gray's (Buster Keaton) beloved locomotive, the General, he pursues them with the aid of his fiance, Annabelle Lee (Marion Mack) straight through enemy lines. One of the most revered comedies of the silent era.

programme.title: Finding Joy
programme.desc: A struggling writer rediscovers himself, his offbeat family, and what it means to be happy when he meets Joy – a spirited, possibly-dying young woman who asks him to write her obituary.

programme.title: Brazzy Jazzy
programme.desc: When a Brazilian Girl takes on the NYC fashion world, her adventures are sometimes sexy, often funny but always Caffeinated! It's Jane the Virgin meets Girls, only an outsider immigrant version - more like Girls of the 3rd World.

programme.title: Growing Op
programme.desc: In an average American neighborhood, a family of four breaks all conformity making it difficult for their 18 year old son to fit in to society.

programme.desc: CITIZEN DUANE is a comedy/drama about Duane Balfour a teen-aged Don Quixote born into a family of spectacular failure. What starts as a simple schoolyard rivalry snowballs out of control when Duane decides to run for mayor of the tiny town of Ridgeway. If Duane is to succeed, he must not only overcome the powerful incumbents, but also his own inadequacies, public perception, and history itself.

programme.title: The Flying Deuces
programme.desc: When two bumbling friends join the French Foreign Legion on a whim, they find themselves in a whirlwind of misadventures, love, and laughter as they attempt to navigate the challenges of military life in a foreign land.

programme.title: Perfect Girl
programme.desc: A coming of age romance for anyone who's ever had a crush. Since high school, Stan and Jenny have had crushes on each other. They wrote letters to one another over school holidays but in person they barely spoke; sharing only the occasional lingering glance and smile. Over the years they fantasized about how perfect they would be as lovers. Ten years later they bump into each other and have the chance to make it a reality, but it's not that simple; self doubt, fear of rejection, of losing their fantasies will hold them back from what could be the perfect union.

programme.title: I Would Have Kissed You
programme.desc: Three months after college graduation, best friends Mattie and Olivia are struggling to write a feature and struggling even more with their love lives. Mattie finds herself in a grey area with her college ex-boyfriend while Olivia clings to the hope that her crush will finally want to be with her (despite his hot new girlfriend.) British Web Awards - Awarded "Best Writing in a Dramedy" and "Best Music" Top Indie Awards -Awarded "Best Humor" WRPN Women's International Film Festival - Awarded "Exceptional Merit Award"

programme.title: The General
programme.desc: When Union spies steal Johnnie Gray's (Buster Keaton) beloved locomotive, the General, he pursues them with the aid of his fiance, Annabelle Lee (Marion Mack) straight through enemy lines. One of the most revered comedies of the silent era.

programme.title: Finding Joy
programme.desc: A struggling writer rediscovers himself, his offbeat family, and what it means to be happy when he meets Joy – a spirited, possibly-dying young woman who asks him to write her obituary.

programme.title: Brazzy Jazzy
programme.desc: When a Brazilian Girl takes on the NYC fashion world, her adventures are sometimes sexy, often funny but always Caffeinated! It's Jane the Virgin meets Girls, only an outsider immigrant version - more like Girls of the 3rd World.

programme.title: ADCC - Denver Opens
programme.desc: The Opens make their way to the mile high city where the best martial arts from the US look to stake their claim for supremacy as the circuit heats up. In this heart-pounding instalment, we bring you all the action from the epic showdown held in the magnificent city of Denver. Former UFC Strawweight Champion of the World Rose Namajunas known for her exceptional martial arts abilities, Rose is now ready to put her skills to the ultimate test in the realm of grappling. Witness her transition from the cage to the mats, as she grapples her way through some of the most intense matches of her career. ADCC Opens superstar and prodigy 16-year-old phenom, Helena Craver, steps onto the mats to showcase her unparalleled talent. With her sights set on glory, she aims to conquer the teenage, adults, and absolute divisions a feat that has never been done before. In a clash of titans, long time elite grappler Ryan Aitkens, a formidable competitor in his own right, is set to go head-to-head against the multiple-time world champion, Mateus Lutes. Brace yourself for an explosive battle between these two grappling juggernauts, as they leave everything on the mats in pursuit of victory.

programme.title: Stuart Cooper Films - The Craig Jones Story
programme.desc:
A short documentary telling the story of Craig Jones' sudden rise to success after his upset victory over Leandro Lo at ADCC 2017. After his breakout performance at ADCC, Craig went on to beat many more big names such as Jake Shields In Polaris, and made it to the finals of EBI, where he had a close finals match against Gordon Ryan. Since then Craig has competed in some of the biggest tournaments in the world and his life has changed dramatically. In this film we see that it wasn't always an easy road for him.
Director Stuart Cooper

programme.title: Tap Out Challenge - Oceanside
programme.desc: On October 15th at the picturesque Oceanside, CA, Charles Rials embarked on an incredible BJJ journey, challenging strangers from all walks of life to tap me out and claim $100. But there was a twist that none of them saw coming! Win or Lose, they got the MONEY!!! What they all shared was the courage to step up, the passion to engage, and the heart of a warrior. This video isn't just about BJJ or the challenge — it's a celebration of the human spirit, perseverance, and the unexpected twists that life (and jiu jitsu) can throw our way. Join Charles in this heartwarming, adrenaline-pumping journey where every challenge was met with respect, and every challenger was met with a surprise. Whether you're a BJJ enthusiast or someone who loves to witness genuine human moments, this video has something special for you.

programme.title: Just for Laughs Presents: - Ethnical Difficulties Comedy Special
programme.desc: It’s a full slate of the top multi-ethnic comedians the world has to offer, all hosted by Indo-Canadian comedy megastar-on-the-rise Sugar Sammy. Don’t miss the multi-national comedy mosaic that is Just For Laughs Ethnical Difficulties, which includes sell-out sensation Gabriel Iglesias (Mexican-American), Aron Kader (Arab-American), Wil Sylvince (Haitian-American), Ron Josol (Filipino-Canadian), Mo Mandel (Jewish-American) and Bret Ernst (Italian-American). All superb comics in their own right, but when together make for one hilarious, very deep international comedy pool.

programme.title: Just for Laughs Presents: Sir Patrick Stewart: A Knight of Comedy
programme.desc: Sir Patrick Stewart, Knight of the Realm, brings all the wit, elegance, and gravitas you’d expect from a British thespian to the Just For Laughs stage. He’s a former member of the Royal Shakespeare Company and a fictional Star Ship captain, marking the first time a bona fide knight in shining armour has hosted a Just For Laughs gala. Join Sir Patrick for a star-studded evening of comedy, featuring the hilarious Sebastian Maniscalco, Gina Yashere, Russell Howard, Jim Breuer, and Pete Zedlacher.

programme.title: Just for Laughs Presents: - Chris Robinson: Panning for Gold

programme.desc: Poplar River First Nation comedian, Paul Rabliauskas, brings his hilarious observational humour to Montreal where he talks about everything from white people and land acknowledgements to being single during the pandemic in this uproariously funny stand-up comedy special from Just For Laughs.

programme.title: Just for Laughs Presents: - Kyle Brownrigg: Introducing Lyle

Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 422 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3 from Oradea, Romania. Up first in an ISKA Super Middleweight World Title match, Vinicius Bereta of Brazil takes on Adrian Maxim of Romania with the belt on the line. In the Colossal Division with a total of 723 pounds in the ring, Cristian Anheliuc and Sandu Lungu face off. The ISKA Super Middleweight Wordl title is on the line when Camaroon's Brice Kombou takes on Romania's Andrei Leustean.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 450 - DMG Boxing presents Night of Champions IV part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents DMG Boxing Night of Champions IV part 1 from The Fox Theater in Pomona, Califorinia. Starting off the night, Adan Gonzales out of Denver takes to the ring in a southpaw matchup with Dedrick Crocklem of Seattle with a 3-0 record. Also on this card, Samuel Isak takes on Chris Pacheco making his pro-debut. Watch as veteran boxer Vaughn Alexander returns to the DMG ring from St. Louis to take on unstoppable Ruben Cazales with a record of 12-0 and 11 KO's in a super middleweight battle.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 453 - DMG Boxing presents Night of Champions IV part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents DMG Boxing Night of Champions IV part 2 from The Fox Theater in Pomona, California. Starting off with a female bout, undefeated fighters Olympian Brianda Cruz and Susana Lopez step into the ring to fight for their perfect record. In the main event is another battle of the undefeated as David Romero takes on Pedro Valencia who is coming off of a three year hiatus.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 371 - KOK Best Of Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Best of King of Kings part 2. In a boxing match Naglis Tamasevicius faces Juris Zundovskis. In a clash of the titans, heavyweight Martin Pacas is matched up against Turkey's Kadir Yildirim "The Terminator." Farshad Derekeh of the Netherlands and Latvian Reinis Porozovs take to the ring in a boxing bout and Beka Gabisonia faces Farruh Gafurov in the Mega Series.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 379 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 part 1 from London. Starting us off is a match between Jonny "The Zombie" Lawson and Ryan McCann and in a female bout, with both fighters making their BKB debut is Stephanie Dy versus Danni Lee. Also faceing off are Tyrone Eliffe and Richard Samuels and George Taylor and Andrei Nastac take to the ring to battle it out in a heavyweight bare knuckle match.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 380 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 part 2 from London. Watch as Kamil Sokolowski and Bri Morrow trade punches in a challenging matchup. Peter Hayes and Adam Grogan face off in the ring and Tony Barratt takes on Ryan Barrett. Also Ionel Levitchi of Romania and George Hillyard from London take to the ring.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 381 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 part 3 from London. Dan Gittens and Marcin "Psycho" Kosiak step into the ring while Eryk Majda faces Kevin Greenwood with the British heavyweight title on the line. Romanian Bogdan Suru takes on Welsh Ash Williams and in the main event, two BKB veterans Scott McHugh and Tony Lafferty head to the ring for the World Flywieght Title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 420 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1 from Oradea, Romania. Starting in the heavyweight division, Remus Bortea is matched up against Vasile Corcodel whose three wins are all by KO. In a Superfight middleweight division bout, Darius Argyo takes on Andrei "The Bonecrusher" Varga in what's expected to be a fast paced bout. Also in this episode is Brazil versus Romania with two very experienced fighters, Rodrigo Mineiro takes on Claudio "The Prince" Badoi in an open weight division fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 421 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2 from Oradea, Romania. In the Super Middleweight division Steven Mendes from France takes on Romania's more experienced Andrei Ostrovanu with 42 wins (24 by KO). In an ISKA Cruiserweight World Title match, Vasileios Karagkiozis and Sebastian Lutanic vie for the belt in a Greece versus Romania bout. Also, in an open weight division Tolea Ciumac and Bogdan Nastase face off in a David versus Goliath match

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 444 - Fightbook Presents: The Butterfly Brawl part 1

Also watch as undefeated Isaiah Carr faces the Philllipines' Daniel Lim. In the middleweight division Poland's Eryk Apresyan faces Terrell "The Sharpshooter" Adams.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 449 - Fightbook Presents: The Butterfly Brawl part 2

Next up, Brandon Mendoza faces Deni Davtian and topping off the night, the main event features a women's matchup with the hometown favorite and rising star Chantel Navarro taking on two time world champion Nancy Franco.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 424 - KOK 122 Riga
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK 122 from Riga, Latvia. In the main event Rodrigo Mineiro and Zaurs Dzavadovs battle for the Interim Welterweight Championship belt.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 364 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 34 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 34 part 1 from London. Also John Collier takes on Jonny Lawson with 16 BKB fights under his belt and in a superweight title clash Danylo Hrebenuyk and undefeated Matty Moore touch gloves.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 365 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 34 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 34 part 2 from London. With the British Featherweight Title up for grabs, Reece Murray and Martin Reffell battle for the belt. In the main event, Aaron McCallum and Mark Tiffin are set to meet the challenge with the bantamweight title on the line.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 342 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 32 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 32 part 1 from London. In the main event is another battle of the undefeated as David Romero takes on Pedro Valencia who is coming off of a three year hiatus.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 371 - KOK Best Of Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Best of King of Kings part 2. In a boxing match Naglis Tamasevicius faces Juris Zundovskis. In a clash of the titans, heavyweight Martin Pacas is matched up against Turkey's Kadir Yildirim "The Terminator." Farshad Derekeh of the Netherlands and Latvian Reinis Porozovs take to the ring in a boxing bout and Beka Gabisonia faces Farruh Gafurov in the Mega Series.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 370 - CFC 17 Rex Mundi
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championship 17 Rex Mundi from Rio De Janeiro. Up first Maruicio Otalora faces Eduardo Souza and Thiago Lima arm-bar specialist takes on the explosive Andre Borges. Also fighting tonight William Baraka and Jiolton Lutterbach and the winner of the Souza-Lima faces Ronys Torres in the finals of the four-man tournament.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 439 - KOK - Best of part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings from Lithuania. Walid Poyan faces Emilijus Kaganovicius in the Lightweight division and Ilir Bega steps into the ring with Ignas Pauliukevicius for a Heavyweight bout. Also in this episode Ivans Kozecenkovs and Deividas Zamba take to the ring for what's expected to be a highly intense battle. Marius Kutauskas, making his pro-debut is matched up against Samuelis Sorochovas. Watch as Likas Lapinskas takes on Arturs Skabarnieks in an MMA Heavyweight bout and in a Lightweight matchup, Morroco's Anas Hilboui takes on Afghanistan's Tamim Shariffi in a very evenly matched fight. Also, in a Lightweight bout, Christiano Silva faces off against the much more experienced Mindaugas Narauskas.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 360 - KOK 104 World Series Kaunas Part 1

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 361 - KOK 104 World Series Kaunas Part 2

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 362 - KOK 104 World Series Kaunas Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 104 World Series Kaunas, Lithuania part 3. programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 255 - KOK’84 World Series, Vilnius part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 1. In a battle between Lithuanian fighters, Zygimantas Kidikas making his pro debut goes up against his 2-0 opponent Ovidijus Pocius. Watch as Aleh Moshin (Belarus) faces Samuelis Sorochovas (Lithuania), Osvaladas Fedorovic takes on the less experienced Aurimas Krukauskas in a battle between Lithuanian fighters and Vladislav Shatunskui (Poland) battles against Gustas Dimsa (Lithuania). In addition Polish fighter Hubert Dylewski takes on Lithuanian Jan Naus in a very evenly matched fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 256 - KOK’84 World Series, Vilnius Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 2. In this episode, watch as Ukrainian Volodymyr Hynzhu takes on Lithuanian Raimondas Avlasevicius, Finn Larsen (Ireland) goes up against the more experienced Nauris Lukosiunas (Lithuania) and Oleskil Mykhailo 9-0 (Ukraine) faces Henrikas Viksraitis 43-7(Lithuania). In the main event Lithuanians Zygimantas Ramaska and Vitoldas Jagelo face one another in an MMA Bushido battle with at title on the line.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 257 - Shamrock FC 334
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock Fighting Championship out of the Ameristar Casino in St. Charles, MO. In this event Austin Miller faces Arvin Mills in the cage, Arnez Ferguson takes on Pat Vega in a kickboxing bout and in a female match, Livvy Pecher takes on Lora Campbell. Also Jason Gavril faces Isaac Dancy and Nico Alcaraz takes on Todd Madden in the middleweight division. In the Co-Main event Devin Anderson takes on Aushton Elleby Midkiff and in the main event Jeremiah Curtright with a 3 fight win streak takes on Zack Davis with a 4 fight win streak.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 258 - UFA Presents the Fighter's Only World MMA Awards XIII
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the 13th annual Fighter's Only 2021 World MMA Awards from Worre Studios in Las Vegas, hosted by Chael Sonnen. Presentations by Dave Farra, Jessy Jess, Doggface208, Emily Whitmire, Cassie Scherbo, Jay Hieron, Dan Henderson, Kayla Harrison, Mackenzie Dern, and more.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 259 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 1. Young Estonian fighters Stanislav Teniugin and Siim Viljus battle under KOK Kickboxing rules. Aleh Moshin from Belarus takes on Karl Margus Haud out of Estonia and Edvinas Bubelis (Lithuania) faces Sergei Strinza (Estonia). Also, powerhouse Volodymyr Hynzju from Ukraine takes on Aleksey Larin from Estonia.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 260 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 2. Watch as the first ever KOK women's bantamweight world championship title is on the line. In some intense all-female matchups each fighter is vying to move on to the finals for a chance at the title. In the semi-finals Estonians Sigrid Kapanen and Astrid Johanna Grents fight to move on and Italian Ludovica Ciarpaglini faces Polish Ilona Woijda to see who will move on to the Grand Prix final match and have a chance at the title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 261 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 3. Watch as Canadian Mohammed Shushan faces Jevgeni "Zora XXL" Ravlusevits of Estonia and Dzmitry Varats (Belarus) takes on Ott Remmer (Estonia).

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 262 - Shamrock FC 335
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock 335 from Ameristar Casino St Charles. Watch as Pat Gordon takes on Adam Stone, Stanton Ketcherside faces Jerry Ing, Matt Tinker battles it out against James Yarbrough, Kevin Mueller faces Trevon Crawford and Tavae Lewis faces Josh Weston In the co-main event in a kickboxing bout, Ian Zarvos faces Cody Naucke and in the main event Josh Augustin returns to the cage after a long layoff to take on blackbelt Thomas Thatcher.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 263 - SFT 30 - Predador vs Manchinha
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents SFT 30 from Brazil. Denis Araujo with 6 KO's meets Jose Reborn Alexandre in the cage for a fierce MMA bout. In the main event Wellington Predador faces Thiago Manchinha in an exciting matchup.

programme.title: The New Guest
programme.desc: When a man and woman check into a remote cabin to complete a therapy exercise, they soon realize they will encounter more than they bargained for.

programme.title: Dietroit

programme.title: Cheaper 2 Keep Her

programme.title: You're Hired!

programme.desc: A frontier family crosses the U.S. by wagon train, hoping for a better life in Oregon.

programme.title: Annie Oakley

programme.title: Annie Oakley

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie has her hands full when she helps an ex-convict so that he can marry his love.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Duke & his gang frame Sam plus kidnap Linda to keep him from proving his innocence. Annie and Lofty must stop a lynch mob, while proving Duke's guilt.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: When outlaws rob the bank, a young rancher does nothing to stop them from leaving town with the money and Annie want to know the reason why.

programme.title: The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog

programme.title: Lights of New York
programme.desc: Two men are conned into bootlegging business.

programme.title: Shadow of a Man

programme.title: Holy Ghost People

programme.title: Impulse
programme.desc: 1954. A Nightclub singer tricks an estate agent into thinking he killed a jewel thief.

programme.title: Lonesome
programme.desc: Two lonely people in the big city meet and enjoy the thrills of an amusement park, only to lose each other in the crowd after spending a great day together. Will they ever see each other again?

programme.title: Smart Alec

programme.title: The Mysterious Island

programme.title: Annie Oakley

programme.title: Annie Oakley

programme.title: Annie Oakley

programme.title: Annie Oakley

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Lofty has jailed Hugo but he won't reveal the location of the stolen loot. Annie thinks if they let Hugo escape they can trail him but they don't count on him kidnapping Tagg. Tagg, as a hostage, makes Hugo's life miserable.

programme.title: Annie Oakley

programme.title: Annie Oakley

programme.title: Annie Oakley

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie has double duty this time when she matches wits with twin sisters. With pistols and boots she has to do battle with this dynamite duo.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: When hes unable to save his own father, Diablo's town doctor loses his confidence in himself. It's up to Annie to convince him that Diablo needs him.

programme.title: Joan the Woman

programme.title: Winds of Chance

programme.title: Sentence of Death
programme.desc: A woman witnesses a murder during a store robbery but claims the accused man (James Dean) is not the killer. After he is convicted and weeks away from his execution date, she sees the real killer, but the police are reluctant to reopen the case.

programme.title: Mutiny in Outer Space
programme.desc: An expedition to the lunar ice caves contracts a deadly moon fungus. Stopping en route, they contaminate a space station with the fungus, which soon begins to start killing off astronauts on their trip back from the moon.

programme.title: Black Dragons
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, the FBI is called in to investigate a series of murders targeting prominent industrialists and their bizarre connection to the now-abandoned Japanese embassy.

programme.title: The Intruder

programme.title: Blind Spot
programme.desc: A blind American Army officer becomes involved in a murder mystery and solves it after regaining his sight.

programme.title: Nightmare in Wax
programme.desc: The disfigured curator of a wax museum murders his enemies and then uses their bodies as exhibits in his museum.

programme.title: To the Shores of Hell

programme.title: A Woman of the World
programme.desc: A sensual European countess arrives at a small American town and quickly provokes moral outrage from the community. During her stay with a cousin, the temptress courts scandal smoking, enticing men, extravagant clothes and a tattoo.

programme.title: Something In The City

programme.title: Cloak Without Dagger

programme.title: The Star Packer

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Panic hits Diablo and the citizens make a run on the bank over worries of solvency. Afraid he will be exposed as a counterfeiter, the banker decides to fake his own death.

programme.title: Annie Oakley

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Outlaws threaten a former rodeo star, crippled in an accident and his wife. Annie saves the day.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Ranch family seems to be angry at the world and want nothing but to be left alone. But Annie tries her best to be friendly, and to find out why.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: When a beautiful woman robs the bank, the young bank teller is accused and it's up to Annie to find evidence to prove he is innocent and shes guilty.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie has to come to the aide of the widow Malloy and her son Dave when they are being threatened to sell their land or suffer more of the same treatment.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Unexpected trouble comes to a rancher when the outlaw brother of an ex-convict comes to the ranch determined to keep his brother from going straight.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: A Judge, who runs a facility to help criminals start over again, has just sentenced an outlaw to hang for his crimes. Now he is threatened by the outlaw's brother if he carries out his verdict.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
